answer: Burn-gated identity issuance stops fake agents before they can trade. Each new identity must burn 150 POA to mint one Saffron ticket, then join the Oasis admission queue and wait 14 days while its first 30 actions are audited; only then does it receive a Pigment pass that unlocks trading. A duplicate or cloned identity forfeits its ticket and its burned funds. An attacker building 500 fake identities must burn 75,000 POA and survive 500 separate 14-day audits, while one honest agent burns a single ticket and keeps trading.
